diagnostics.name: invalid_utf8
diagnostics.meaning: Input is not valid UTF-8.

diagnostics.name: byte_order_mark_forbidden
diagnostics.meaning: A UTF-8 byte-order mark is present.

diagnostics.name: missing_version_header
diagnostics.meaning: The required llmrecog version header is missing or malformed.

diagnostics.name: unsupported_version
diagnostics.meaning: The declared text contract version is not supported.

diagnostics.name: invalid_indentation
diagnostics.meaning: Indentation is not an exact two-space level transition.

diagnostics.name: tab_outside_string
diagnostics.meaning: A raw tab occurs outside a JSON string.

diagnostics.name: malformed_string
diagnostics.meaning: A string violates JSON string syntax.

diagnostics.name: malformed_range
diagnostics.meaning: A text range does not match the 1-based half-open range syntax.

diagnostics.name: trailing_comment
diagnostics.meaning: A comment occurs after another token on a physical line.

diagnostics.name: unexpected_declaration
diagnostics.meaning: A top-level declaration keyword is not part of contract 0.1.

diagnostics.name: unexpected_field
diagnostics.meaning: A field is not valid at this block position.

diagnostics.name: missing_required_field
diagnostics.meaning: A declaration omits a required grammar field.

diagnostics.name: duplicate_field
diagnostics.meaning: A declaration repeats a non-repeatable field.

diagnostics.name: missing_final_newline
diagnostics.meaning: Input lacks the canonical final newline.

diagnostics.name: duplicate_id
diagnostics.meaning: A declaration ID is repeated in the document-wide namespace.

diagnostics.name: reference_unresolved_for_viability
diagnostics.meaning: A referenced declaration ID does not exist.

diagnostics.name: wrong_reference_kind
diagnostics.meaning: A reference resolves to a declaration of the wrong kind.

diagnostics.name: unsupported_record_kind
diagnostics.meaning: A record kind is outside the closed 0.1 registry.

diagnostics.name: record_shape_mismatch
diagnostics.meaning: Record fields do not match its declared kind.

diagnostics.name: unsupported_value_type
diagnostics.meaning: A variable value type is outside the closed 0.1 registry.

diagnostics.name: candidate_value_type_mismatch
diagnostics.meaning: A candidate value does not match its parent variable value type.

diagnostics.name: candidate_parent_mismatch
diagnostics.meaning: The candidate header and variable candidate list disagree.

diagnostics.name: unsupported_constraint_kind
diagnostics.meaning: A constraint kind is outside the closed 0.1 registry.

diagnostics.name: constraint_shape_mismatch
diagnostics.meaning: Constraint fields do not match its declared kind.

diagnostics.name: empty_one_of
diagnostics.meaning: A one_of constraint has no members.

diagnostics.name: one_of_member_mismatch
diagnostics.meaning: A one_of member is not a candidate of the referenced variable.

diagnostics.name: constraint_operand_kind_mismatch
diagnostics.meaning: A constraint operand is not the required candidate or variable kind.

diagnostics.name: invalid_digest
diagnostics.meaning: A digest is not lowercase sha256 followed by 64 hexadecimal digits.

diagnostics.name: invalid_range_order
diagnostics.meaning: A source range end does not follow its start.

diagnostics.name: invalid_observed_at
diagnostics.meaning: A source observed_at value is not an RFC 3339 timestamp.

diagnostics.name: missing_provenance_path
diagnostics.meaning: A semantic declaration has no provenance path.

diagnostics.name: constraint_relationship_ungrounded
diagnostics.meaning: A constraint lacks grounding for the relationship itself.

diagnostics.name: unsealed_source
diagnostics.meaning: A locatable source has no exact digest.

diagnostics.name: positive_support_missing
diagnostics.meaning: A candidate or record has no positive support record.

diagnostics.name: forbidden_reasoning_role
diagnostics.meaning: A reasoning, decision, or realization role is declared as recognition.

diagnostics.name: inference_promoted_to_source_fact
diagnostics.meaning: A downstream inference artifact is presented as original-source recognition.

diagnostics.name: ungrounded_exhaustiveness
diagnostics.meaning: Exhaustiveness is assumed without a grounded closure constraint.

diagnostics.name: empty_closed_domain
diagnostics.meaning: A closed variable has no satisfying assignment.

diagnostics.name: supported_but_excluded
diagnostics.meaning: A source-supported candidate is excluded by grounded constraints.

diagnostics.name: normalization_grounding_incomplete
diagnostics.meaning: Normalization lacks its rule, grounded input, or required context anchor.

diagnostics.name: confidence_used_semantically
diagnostics.meaning: Producer confidence is used as a weight, exclusion, or ranking rule.

reasons.name: open_domain
reasons.meaning: Unlisted values may exist because no grounded closure applies.

reasons.name: no_declared_candidate
reasons.meaning: No bounded candidate represents a value for the requested variable.

reasons.name: unresolved_reference
reasons.meaning: A required declaration reference is unresolved.

reasons.name: unresolved_constraint_operand
reasons.meaning: A constraint cannot be evaluated because an operand is unresolved.

reasons.name: unsupported_constraint_version
reasons.meaning: The requested semantic scope contains an unsupported constraint version.

reasons.name: scope_incomplete
reasons.meaning: The requested scope omits a required transitive constraint dependency.

reasons.name: limit_reached
reasons.meaning: A declared evaluation or enumeration limit prevented completion.

reasons.name: source_not_verified
reasons.meaning: The query policy required source verification that was not established.

reasons.name: candidate_witness_found
reasons.meaning: A represented satisfying assignment contains the candidate.

reasons.name: one_of_single_remaining
reasons.meaning: A grounded one_of has one remaining viable member in scope.

reasons.name: excludes_pair_forbidden
reasons.meaning: A grounded excludes constraint forbids the two candidate assignments together.

reasons.name: requires_consequent_unavailable
reasons.meaning: An antecedent assignment cannot occur because its required consequent is unavailable.

reasons.name: same_as_value_mismatch
reasons.meaning: A joint assignment violates grounded variable equality.

reasons.name: distinct_from_value_collision
reasons.meaning: A joint assignment gives grounded-distinct variables the same value.

reasons.name: no_satisfying_witness
reasons.meaning: All represented assignments containing the candidate violate grounded constraints.
